RTPT modification (2026-10-19): SharcCommon.h has an opt-in
RTPT_SHARC_SPLIT_RESOLVE path with immutable hash/resolved inputs and separate
resolve destinations for VXPG-A's paired local/suffix cache. The default path
is unchanged. No shared Falcor framework or material implementation is modified.
